1.q: Do I need to install anything?
1.a: No. Parcolia opens in the browser, on phone, tablet or computer.

2.q: Can my staff see my revenue?
2.a: No. Staff do the daily work (bookings, contracts, fleet) but see neither money nor statistics.

3.q: What happens at the end of the trial?
3.a: Nothing is lost. Without a plan, the agency becomes read-only until payment.

4.a: Each agency only sees its own data. You can download everything as Excel or delete your agency at any time.

5.q: Can I print and send contracts?
5.a: Yes: every contract is ready as a PDF in your name, to print or send to the client on WhatsApp.
